# ONNX Runtime Web 1.30.0

Only the WASM CPU distribution is vendored, from the matching npm package via
jsDelivr. All three SHA-256 hashes were checked against its package file manifest.
See manifest.json. JavaScript and WASM versions must be updated together.

Upstream: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/v1.30.0
License: MIT, retained in LICENSE. No model weights are bundled here.
